task.title: Deny access to your account
task.shortdesc: As a customer and Organization Administrator, you can deny access to your account by denying the Red Hat access request.

ul.li: A Red Hat support engineer created an access request.
The access request appears in the Red Hat Account Requests list.

prereq.p: You can view a list of all account access requests and their statuses from the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > Red Hat Access Requests.
prereq.note: Only the Organization Administrator can approve or deny an access request. The User Access administrator role does not provide permissions to approve or deny an access request.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > Red Hat Access RequestsRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > Red Hat Access Requests window.

info.p: A list of all access requests is displayed.

step.cmd: The recommended approach is that you click on the Request ID number, a string of hexadecimal digits.
Carefully review the request details and the Roles requested.
Click Deny to approve the request. The action is confirmed and the status changes to Denied.
Use the edit function to change your response.
